From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About The Role BLP only works when it talks to our customers' ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for our customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You'll take ownership of integrations across ERPs such as Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS and abas, and help us connect to the next one. What you’ll do Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, OData, direct DB access and file transfers. Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them. Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers. Hands-on integration experience with at least one ERP system (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS, ABAS or similar), ideally more than one. Why BLP Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live. Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards. Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares. Team: regular team events. Practical information Location: We have an office in Zurich, London, Munich and Cologne, hybrid with 3+ office days per week in those locations or remotely from anywhere in Europe. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Foreign Exchange Associate In This Role, You Will The Associate will be responsible for the timely and accurate settlement of Treasury products on behalf of several of our HSBC entities. The role supports end-to-end operations covering trade validation, confirmation, settlements, and investigations in adherence to the relevant currency funding and payment cut-offs. Provide an excellent level of service and support taking ownership of issues where applicable. Provide a single point of contact for the satellite sites and enhance the operational relationship between entities, group offices and their customers. Continually evaluate existing controls, challenging current procedures and suggesting enhancements as appropriate. An individual contributor supporting critical operations that include settlements, confirmation & post settlement within the department supporting FXMM product lines and initiatives. Manages the daily operations ensuring that customers receive quality service through all channels of customer contact. Ensures achievement of Performance Level Agreement (PLA) targets by the team, prevent, and mitigate operational losses. The jobholder will also continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology. To Be Successful You Will Degree in finance/management/business administration or related discipline. Good all-round product knowledge and MS Office skills and a willingness to further develop both. Experience or Knowledge of Foreign exchange, Money Markets, Fixed Income, Derivatives and it’s types. Understand and ensure compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business. You’ll achieve more at HSBC Hsbc.com/careers HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible work and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
